# DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform — Full Content
> Comprehensive content reference for AI agents and crawlers.
> For the short discovery index, see /llms.txt.
> Tagline: Intelligence from Web.
> Brand: DatIQ (one word; capital I, capital Q).

---

## 1. Disambiguation

DatIQ (this product) is a no-code web intelligence platform for extracting structured data from any public URL. It is NOT related to:
- "DAT iQ" / "DATiQ" — a freight rate intelligence product by IntelliTrans / Trimble (North American trucking market)
- "DAT" (without "iQ") — the parent DAT freight & load-board company
- "Data IQ" / "DataIQ" — a generic analytics consultancy term, used by multiple unrelated firms

DatIQ.app is the canonical product. The brand is styled "DatIQ" (one word, capital I, capital Q).

---

## 2. What DatIQ Does

DatIQ extracts and enriches data from any publicly accessible web page using AI. Users paste a URL and immediately receive:

- **Structured headings** (H1–H6) in document order
- **Internal and external links**, AI-categorized
- **AI-generated summary** in plain language
- **Contact information** (leadership names, email addresses, social profiles) when "Contacts & emails" is enabled
- **Pricing data** (structured tiers) when extracted
- **Custom fields** described in plain English — "extract all board members with titles", "find every API endpoint mentioned", etc.
- **Domain map** — every indexed URL on the site (when "Map entire domain" is enabled)
- **PDF / CSV export** of all of the above

No code required. Background processing keeps the page responsive. Results persist to your account and are re-loadable on any device.

---

## 3. Core Capabilities (Detailed)

### Web extraction
- Headings H1 through H6 in document order
- All internal and external links, with text and aria-label
- Page metadata: title, description, OpenGraph, Twitter Card
- JavaScript rendering option (via Firecrawl `waitFor: 3000`) for SPAs
- Honors `robots.txt` and `noindex` by default

### AI summary
- Plain-language overview of any page
- Model: Anthropic Claude (configurable)
- 2-3 sentence default; longer for rich content

### Custom extraction
- User describes any field in plain English
- Examples: "Extract every executive with their title and LinkedIn URL", "Pull all product SKUs and prices", "Find every API endpoint mentioned"
- Returns structured JSON ready for export

### Domain mapping
- Discovers every URL on a site that is crawlable
- Routes to Firecrawl's `/map` endpoint
- Searchable list view; click any URL to extract

### Contact extraction
- Surface leadership names, email addresses, social profiles
- Auto-populates a leadership/board contact prompt
- One-click Quick Enrichment button on the preview page

### Pricing extraction
- Structured pricing tiers from any pricing page
- Captures plan names, prices, billing cadence, key features
- Excel-ready output

### Content generation
- SEO Blog Outline — heading structure + meta + key topics
- Competitor Summary — side-by-side teardown
- Social Posts — 3-5 LinkedIn / X posts from any extracted page
- Compare — 2-URL battlecard
- Explain — plain-English explainer for any page

### Scheduled monitoring
- Hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly
- Alert on change (heading, link, content hash, or custom field)
- Email + in-app notification
- Pro and above

### Batch processing
- Multiple URLs in one run
- Per-URL status (success / fail / retry)
- CSV bulk export
- Pro and above

### Export & integrations
- **CSV** — comprehensive, every enrichment included (deep-flattened JSON paths)
- **PDF** — jsPDF report, same complete content
- **Google Sheets** — Open-in-Google-Sheets with one click
- **HubSpot / Salesforce** — push contacts and companies
- **Webhooks** — fire-and-forget POST on extraction complete
- **Email delivery** — send extractions to any address
- **API** — POST /api/extract, POST /api/ai, GET /api/stats
- **White-label PDF** (Business + Agency) — upload a single-page PDF template; every export renders on top of it

### Plan-level features
- **White-label PDF** (Business + Agency): upload a single-page PDF template in /account; every PDF export and invoice is rendered on top of your branded background.
- **Priority support** (Business + Agency): contact-form submissions are routed through a faster SLA.
- **Extra Workspace add-on**: same features as the parent plan, capped at the parent plan's team-seats limit (e.g. 3 seats on Business).
- **Enterprise**: SSO, DPA, SLA, on-prem — contact sales.

### Billing
- Razorpay + UPI for Indian customers (auto-detected)

- Numbered, itemized invoice or receipt issued on every payment
- PDF invoice emailed automatically
- View, download, and re-send every invoice from the Account screen
- GSTIN captured on every Indian invoice

## 5. Target Users (Personas)

DatIQ is designed for seven core personas. Each has a tailored home-screen example, dashboard label, and onboarding flow:

1. **Sales / SDR / BDR** — Turn any company website into a qualified prospect in 30 seconds. Extract contacts, leadership, mission, summary.
2. **Competitive Intelligence** — Monitor competitor pricing, messaging, leadership changes. Full teardown in 5 minutes.
3. **SEO / Content Marketer** — Audit any site's H1→H6, link profile, content gaps. No setup required.
4. **Market Researcher** — Map your entire market landscape at machine speed. Aggregate missions, pricing, leadership.
5. **Recruiter** — Source leadership, contact info, hiring signals from any company. Build a sourcing database.
6. **Startup Founder / VC** — 10× faster due diligence. AI brief, team, pricing from any startup URL.
7. **Agency / Enterprise** — Extract at scale across clients, competitors, and data pipelines. White-label ready.

## 6. Use Cases

### Lead Generation
Extract contact info, company details, and LinkedIn profiles from any public-facing business page. Build prospect lists in minutes.
- Extract emails, phone numbers, job titles
- Capture company size, funding, industry
- Batch-process 100s of company URLs
- Export to CSV or push to CRM
- See: /use-cases/lead-generation

### Competitor Research
Monitor competitor pricing, feature pages, and messaging. Get AI-summarised insights on what changed and why.
- Track pricing page changes automatically
- Extract product features & positioning copy
- Compare multiple competitors side by side
- Scheduled monitoring with email alerts
- See: /use-cases/competitor-research

### SEO Audit
Extract headings, meta tags, structured data, and internal links to identify SEO gaps without expensive tooling.
- Extract H1–H6, title, meta description
- Identify missing schema markup
- Audit anchor text & link structure
- Batch-audit entire site in one run
- See: /use-cases/seo-audit

### Market Research
Aggregate product reviews, news articles, and industry reports into a structured dataset — ready for analysis.
- Scrape reviews from G2, Capterra, App Store
- Pull news headlines & publication dates
- Aggregate pricing across competitors
- Export structured JSON for analysis
- See: /use-cases/market-research

### Price Monitoring
Track product prices across competitors and marketplaces. Alerted when prices change.
- Monitor competitor prices daily or weekly
- Track your own product prices on marketplaces
- Historical price trend export
- Alert when price drops below threshold

### Content Research
Extract article structures, FAQs, and key topics from top-ranking pages to inform your content strategy.
- Extract article outlines & heading structure
- Identify questions & FAQs on ranking pages
- Aggregate content gaps across 20+ pages
- AI-generated content brief from any URL

### Additional use cases
- **HR & Recruiting** — job postings, candidate profiles, career pages
- **Real Estate Research** — property listings, rentals, neighbourhood data
- **E-commerce Catalogue** — product names, descriptions, SKUs, prices
- **Compliance Monitoring** — ToS, privacy policy, regulatory announcements
- **News & Media Monitoring** — headlines, press releases, brand mentions
- **API & Developer Data** — structured JSON for RAG / LLM pipelines

## 8. FAQ (12 questions and answers)

**Q1. What is DatIQ?**
DatIQ is a no-code web intelligence platform that turns any public URL into structured data — headings, links, contacts, pricing, AI summaries, and custom fields — in seconds.

**Q2. How is DatIQ different from Clay, Browse.ai, or Firecrawl?**
DatIQ combines plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, and full CSV/PDF export in one no-code product. It is significantly cheaper than Clay, simpler than Firecrawl, and more feature-rich than Browse.ai.

**Q3. How much does DatIQ cost?**
DatIQ is free to start — 10 extractions per month, no credit card. Paid plans start at $19 / month (Select, 100 extractions + PDF export). Pro is $29 / month, Business $79 / month, Agency $299 / month. Annual plans get a 20% discount. INR pricing is available.

**Q4. Do I need to write code to use DatIQ?**
No. DatIQ is zero-code — paste a URL, describe any field you want in plain English, and the AI extracts it. Custom extraction is configurable in the UI without scripting.

**Q5. What formats can I export?**
CSV (comprehensive — every enrichment included) and PDF (jsPDF report, customizable with white-label templates on Business and Agency plans). Google Sheets export is available on Pro and above. HubSpot and Salesforce integrations are on Business and above.

**Q6. Can I schedule recurring extractions?**
Yes. Scheduled monitoring is included on Pro, Business, and Agency plans. Schedules can run hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly, and you can attach an alert email to be notified when the page changes.

**Q7. How does DatIQ handle JavaScript-heavy sites?**
The "Render JavaScript" option uses Firecrawl's headless browser with a 3-second wait, which works for React, Vue, Angular, and Next.js SPAs.

**Q8. Is my data private?**
Yes. Extractions are private to your account by default. You can hit "Share" on any extraction to publish a public read-only report at datiq.app/p/<slug>, but the dashboard and saved extractions are account-scoped.

**Q9. Does DatIQ support team workspaces?**
Yes. Business plans include 3 seats, Agency plans include 5 workspaces. Extra Workspace add-ons are available.

**Q10. Is DatIQ GDPR / DPDP / SOC 2 compliant?**
DatIQ is India-first and DPDP Act 2023 compliant. SOC 2 Type II is in progress (target Q4 2026). The admin page documents current compliance posture and DPIA templates.

**Q11. What AI model powers DatIQ?**
DatIQ uses Anthropic Claude for AI enrichment (configurable via env). The default model is optimized for structured extraction tasks. The API is also model-agnostic — you can plug in your own key.

**Q12. How do I cancel my subscription?**
Open Account → Plan → Cancel. You keep access until the end of the billing period, then the account moves to Free. No email hoops, no retention calls.

---

## 9. API

### Endpoints
- `POST /api/extract` — extract structured data from a URL
  - Body: `{ "url": "...", "options": { "renderJs": true, "customPrompt": "..." } }`
  - Returns: `{ "data": { "headings": [...], "links": [...], "summary": "...", "custom": {...} } }`
- `POST /api/ai` — AI enrichment on existing structured data
  - Body: `{ "data": {...}, "prompt": "Extract every executive with title and LinkedIn" }`
  - Returns: `{ "enrichment": {...} }`
- `GET /api/stats` — aggregate statistics (count, last extracted, etc.)
  - Returns: `{ "totalExtractions": ..., "byDomain": {...} }`

### Authentication
- Bearer token in `Authorization` header
- Tokens generated from the Account → API page (Business and Agency plans)
- Rate limits: 60 requests / minute, 10,000 / day (Business); unlimited (Agency)

### Documentation
Full reference: /help/index.html (DatIQ-Developer-API section)

---

## 10. Competitive Context

DatIQ is a no-code alternative to:
- **Clay** — 10× cheaper; DatIQ starts at $19/mo vs Clay's $149/mo. DatIQ's enrichment is built into the extraction, not bolted on.
- **Browse.ai** — More feature-rich (custom extraction, AI enrichment tabs, scheduled monitoring, white-label PDF).
- **Firecrawl** — Simpler. No API key management, no scraping infrastructure to maintain.
- **Diffbot** — Much cheaper. Plain-English config vs ontology training.
- **PhantomBuster** — No proxy rotation costs, no browser quotas.

DatIQ's differentiation: plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, full CSV/PDF export with no setup, India-first (INR + Razorpay + UPI + DPDP), white-label ready.

## 12. Technical Stack

- **Frontend:** Vite 5 + React 18 + React Router 6
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + CSS custom-property design tokens
- **Icons:** lucide-react
- **Auth + DB:** Supabase (Postgres + auth)
- **Extraction:** Firecrawl (`/v1/scrape` + `/v1/map`)
- **AI enrichment:** Anthropic Claude (configurable)
- **Serverless:** Netlify Functions (Node.js)
- **Payments:** Razorpay (India) + Stripe (international)
- **PDF export:** jsPDF (lazy-loaded, only on export click)
- **Test framework:** Vitest + Playwright + jsdom

## 14. How to Get Started

1. Visit https://datiq.app/
2. Paste any public URL into the composer
3. Click "Extract" — you get headings, links, and an AI summary in seconds
4. Try Quick Enrichment — one-click capabilities for contacts, leadership, social, mission, pricing
5. Save the extraction to your account (free plan: 10 / month)
6. Export as CSV, PDF, or open in Google Sheets
7. Optional: sign up for a paid plan to unlock scheduled monitoring, batch, API, and white-label PDF

No credit card required to start. No setup. No API keys. Just paste and go.
